name: Edificio Quindio: Critical Path and Fast-Tracking
description: Owner just demanded 6-week-earlier delivery on a baselined 38-week construction CPM, while a Week-12 progress shock has eaten the float. Diagnose the schedule, absorb the variance, rank fast-tracking and crashing options by cost-per-week, and defend a go / counter-offer / decline recommendation that survives the owner CFO and the bank covenant.

Distinguish total vs free float.

Week-12 progress is in. SPI 0.84, CPI 0.96, BCWS 5,180M, BCWP 4,350M, ACWP 4,530M. The 8-day structural slip just consumed the near-critical float. Decide.
Formula: BAC divided by CPI.
Float migrates after a delay.
The contract requires the SPI to be attached to status reports.
Subs need 2 weeks notice if you plan to expand crews.
Pick a target completion week, then select compression options. Cost-per-week-saved and risk premium decide the right mix.
Friday morning. Steering committee in two hours. Lock the recommendation and the contractual ask.
